name: Training Ray Marching and Integration
aliases: Training Ray Marching and Integration — NeRF Forward Pass
definition: Performs volume rendering for training, including ray generation, adaptive marching with occupancy grid pruning, neural network evaluation, and alpha compositing.
summary: Training Ray Marching and Integration is a differentiable forward pass that synthesizes RGB images from neural radiance fields for gradient-based optimization, distinguished by its inclusion of adaptive sampling and occupancy grid pruning specific to the training loop.
